page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highmem-16-lssd is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the c4d server family. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs and 126.0 GB of RAM, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 7.88 GB per vCPU. The instance includes a bundled local storage configuration consisting of one 403 GB NVMe SSD. No GPUs are included in this configuration, and it does not provide complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities without resource contention. With approximately 8 GB of memory per vCPU, this instance provides a high-density memory profile suitable for memory-intensive operations. The inclusion of a local 403 GB NVMe SSD offers low-latency storage directly attached to the instance, which improves cost efficiency by reducing the reliance on external block storage for temporary data or caching layers.

This server configuration is designed for workloads requiring a balance of high memory capacity and fast local storage. Appropriate use cases include database hosting, in-memory caching, data processing pipelines, and memory-heavy general-purpose applications that benefit from dedicated CPU resources and local NVMe storage.
